note.value: Raiding Boats launch after a ship moves, but before it fires. They do not interact with other ships on the turn they launch (i.e. Bomb Boats don't explode and Raiding Boats don't initiate boarding actions).
note.value_en: Raiding Boats launch after a ship moves, but before it fires. They do not interact with other ships on the turn they launch (i.e. Bomb Boats don't explode and Raiding Boats don't initiate boarding actions).

note.value:
Crew: Carries up to 2 Crew that may initiate boarding actions.
Swivel Gun: 1 Cannon, 180 degree fore turret. Short Range only, no save modifier. May not repel boarders.
note.value_en:
Crew: Carries up to 2 Crew that may initiate boarding actions.
Swivel Gun: 1 Cannon, 180 degree fore turret. Short Range only, no save modifier. May not repel boarders.

note.value: Main weapons may not fire on Boats. Boats may be boarded by a boarding action (note: Bomb Boats will explode prior to the action). Boats within 3" may be fired at using Defensive Fire (1 die per Crew Counter). Boats are hit on a 5+ and have a 4+ save, they can take only 1 hit. Destroyed Boats are removed from play, any crew drowns immediately. Spells may effect Boats (using the 4+ save). Unmanned Boats (except Bomb Boat) are immediately removed from play.
